notablePrerequisites:
Hoard Hauler is a creature and does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Hoard Hauler and controls at least five artifacts.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls five or more artifacts using Hoard Hauler.
Hoard Hauler triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
If the opponent controls six or more artifacts, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.
